description_en: Queries the resettable time range of a topic, which is the production time of the earliest and latest messages stored in the topic
description_zh: 查询Topic可重置的时间范围，即该Topic中储存的最早的和最晚的消息的生产时间
kebab_example: aliyun ons ons-consumer-time-span --group-id GID_test_group_id --topic test-mq_topic --region cn-hangzhou
name: OnsConsumerTimeSpan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the consumer group to query
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The topic subscribed to by the consumer group to query
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消费端Group ID订阅的Topic
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en: The instance ID corresponding to the consumer group ID to query
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消费端Group ID所对应的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

ConsumeTimeStamp.description_en: The latest time when the current consumer group consumed messages from the topic
ConsumeTimeStamp.description_zh: 当前Group消费该Topic的最新时间

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID corresponding to the consumer group ID to query
InstanceId.description_zh: 需查询的消费端Group ID所对应的实例ID

MaxTimeStamp.description_en: The production time of the latest message currently stored in the topic
MaxTimeStamp.description_zh: 整个Topic目前最新存储的消息的生产时间

MinTimeStamp.description_en: The production time of the earliest message currently stored in the topic
MinTimeStamp.description_zh: 整个Topic目前最早存储的消息的生产时间

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. This is a common parameter. The ID of each request is unique and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
